nutrition.title: Nutrition
nutrition.ironTip: Add iron-rich foods to your diet: beef, spinach, lentils. This will help prevent anemia.

exercise.title: Exercise
exercise.yogaTip: Try prenatal yoga. 15 minutes a day will help strengthen your back and prepare for childbirth.

sleep.title: Sleep
sleep.positionTip: Sleep on your left side with a pillow between your legs. This will improve blood circulation to the baby.

mental.title: Mental Health
mental.relaxTip: Practice meditation and breathing exercises to reduce stress.
